key_insight: The Daily Dose (TDD) system enhances clinical workflow by automating summaries and trial identification in radiation oncology.
clinical_relevance: Integration of LLM-driven tools can improve efficiency and satisfaction in clinical practices.
method: Mixed-methods evaluation with a clinician survey after 1 month of use.
Daily automated delivery of personalized email summaries generated by RadOnc-GPT.
Focus on usability, satisfaction, and perceived impact on workflow.
evidence_signal: Among 55 respondents, 94.5% were in radiation oncology, with high usage and satisfaction scores indicated.
watch_item: Potential variability in perceived time savings among users.
paper_title: The Daily Dose: Workflow-Integrated Large Language Model Automation for Clinical Summarization and Trial Identification in Radiation Oncology
